description: Machine-readable release invariant manifest for SentiNews Learn LCMS. Each entry maps to at least one automated test. All invariants must pass before any release.

invariants.name: No hardcoded curriculum in application code
invariants.description: No Python file under backend/app/ may contain curriculum-specific string literals such as domain names, module names, lesson titles, learning outcomes, or learner goal text as branching conditions (if/else based on slug or name substrings). All curriculum meaning must originate from DB rows.

invariants.name: Dynamic module creation — zero code change required
invariants.description: A brand-new module with completely different domain semantics (e.g. Financial Statements, Valuation, Portfolio Management) can be created via POST /curriculum/modules, populated with its own learner_goal/why_this_matters/learning_outcomes, and retrieved with those exact values from GET /curriculum/modules/{slug} — with no application code changes.

invariants.name: StoredBlock closed enum validation
invariants.description: StoredBlock must reject unknown content_type, response_type, and activity_type values with a ValidationError. The enums are closed; no new type can be accepted without an explicit code addition.

invariants.name: Pure content blocks reject evaluation and options
invariants.description: Blocks with response_type=NONE must not carry evaluation secrets or options. The model_validator must raise ValidationError on violation.

invariants.name: SINGLE_CHOICE requires >= 2 options with stable IDs and matching correct_option_id
invariants.description: Every SINGLE_CHOICE block must have at least 2 options with unique IDs. The correct_option_id in evaluation must reference an existing option ID by value, never by array index or position.

invariants.name: IMAGE_SELECTION requires media_asset_id on every option
invariants.description: Every IMAGE_SELECTION option must carry a media_asset_id. Blocks without this field on any option must be rejected at validation time.

invariants.name: TRUE_FALSE requires exactly 2 options
invariants.description: TRUE_FALSE blocks must have exactly 2 options. More or fewer must be rejected with ValidationError.

invariants.name: MASTERY_EVIDENCE requires interactive response type
invariants.description: A block with evidence_role=MASTERY_EVIDENCE and response_type=NONE must be rejected. Mastery evidence requires an evaluatable interaction.

invariants.name: IMAGE content_type requires media reference
invariants.description: A block with content_type=IMAGE must provide a media_asset_id reference. Blocks without it must be rejected.

invariants.name: LearnerBlockSerializer strips all evaluation secrets
invariants.description: The LearnerBlockSerializer must remove: evaluation dict, correct_option_id at any level, correct_value, accepted_answers, and is_correct flags from all options. Zero evaluation secrets may reach the learner client.

invariants.name: Unified session stream: pure content is_interactive=false
invariants.description: Pure-content blocks (response_type=NONE) in the session stream must have is_interactive=false and activity_id=null. They must be present in the stream (not filtered out). Interactive blocks must have is_interactive=true and a non-null activity_id.

invariants.name: Pure-content block position resume
invariants.description: The learner can resume from any position in the unified stream including pure-content blocks. Updating position to a pure-content block index must persist and be returned in GET /learning/sessions/{id} as resume_position.

invariants.name: Media upload: PNG/JPEG/WebP accepted, SVG rejected
invariants.description: The media upload endpoint must accept PNG, JPEG, and WebP files. SVG must be explicitly rejected with SVG_DISABLED_FOR_SECURITY error. Files with invalid magic bytes (fake extension) must be rejected with INVALID_FILE_SIGNATURE.

invariants.name: Media upload deduplication via SHA-256 checksum
invariants.description: Uploading the same file twice must return the same media_asset_id with deduplicated=true. No duplicate rows must be inserted.

invariants.name: ContentProjectionService: no silent objective fabrication
invariants.description: If no valid LearningObjective can be resolved for an evaluatable block, ContentProjectionService must raise ValueError (CANNOT_RESOLVE_LEARNING_OBJECTIVE). It must never silently create a fabricated objective with invented pedagogical meaning.

invariants.name: Deterministic UUID5 activity IDs
invariants.description: LearningActivity IDs must be deterministic: uuid.uuid5(version.id, block_id). Publishing the same version twice must produce identical activity IDs, enabling idempotent re-publication.

invariants.name: Attempt evaluation: correct_option_id used, not array index
invariants.description: Attempt evaluation must use evaluation_spec_snapshot.correct_option_id (a stable UUID string) to determine correctness. Using array index or position to identify the correct answer is forbidden.

invariants.name: Session authorization: deny-by-default, enumeration-resistant 404
invariants.description: Reading or submitting to a session belonging to a different user must return 404 (not 403), providing side-channel equivalence that prevents user enumeration.

invariants.name: Request idempotency: fingerprint is deterministic
invariants.description: The request fingerprint (SHA-256 of user_id + lesson_slug) must be fully deterministic. Identical inputs must always produce identical fingerprints.

invariants.name: Row locking in sorted order to prevent deadlocks
invariants.description: aggregate.py must always acquire concept locks in sorted lexicographic UUID order. This prevents deadlock cycles when concurrent sessions access overlapping concepts.

invariants.name: Published lesson versions are immutable
invariants.description: Attempting to update or re-draft a PUBLISHED LessonVersion must be rejected. The state PUBLISHED → anything except ARCHIVED must be forbidden by ContentService.update_lesson_draft and ContentService.transition_version_status.

invariants.name: Frozen learning-core pipeline has no db.commit()/rollback() calls
invariants.description: No file under backend/app/services/learning/pipeline/ (except orchestrator.py) may call db.commit() or db.rollback(). Transaction boundaries are exclusively managed by the orchestrator.

invariants.name: Learning core is decoupled from auth identity models
invariants.description: No file under backend/app/services/learning/ may import from app.core.auth or import User from app.models.user. UserProfile is permitted.

invariants.name: mark_lesson_completed writes only UserProgress, never ConceptMastery
invariants.description: The single-writer invariant: mark_lesson_completed in LearnerCurriculumStateService must write only to user_progress. It must never directly insert or update concept_mastery. ConceptMastery is exclusively managed by the mastery engine in the learning pipeline.

invariants.name: All active domain model tables registered in Base.metadata
invariants.description: All canonical SQLAlchemy domain models must be importable and registered in Base.metadata. Missing table registrations indicate unlinked models that will fail at runtime.

invariants.name: Bundle hash invariance: adding content does not change frontend build hash
invariants.description: Building the frontend twice — before and after creating new curriculum content via the Admin API — must produce identical JS bundle hashes. New curriculum is DATA, never bundled code.

invariants.name: Frozen learning-core pipeline files are not modified
invariants.description: git diff HEAD -- backend/app/services/learning/pipeline/ must return empty. No pipeline files may be modified by any content, admin, or curriculum feature work.

invariants.name: Arbitrary block ordering is preserved end-to-end
invariants.description: The order of blocks in the session stream must match the order_index field in blocks_json, regardless of insertion order. Adding blocks in any order and then loading the session must produce the correct sorted sequence.

invariants.name: Preview mode produces zero learner-session writes
invariants.description: LiveIsolatedPreview in the Admin Studio renders all block types and evaluates interactive blocks entirely client-side. No network requests to /api/v1/learning/* may be made during preview interaction. This is verified by absence of LearningSession rows created during preview use.

invariants.name: UPDATE_PROGRESS: session position persists independently of attempts
invariants.description: Calling POST /learning/sessions/{id}/progress with a position value must persist it to LearningSession.current_position without creating or mutating any LearningAttempt rows. Progress and attempt submission are completely independent write paths.
